title: Turn product constraints into an inference path
description: Choose a workload and architecture, then change freshness and peak traffic. The diagram and operating consequences update together.

workloads.label: Daily churn outreach
workloads.detail: Scores feed a campaign assembled once each morning.
workloads.stakes: A stale score wastes outreach capacity but does not block a live request.

workloads.label: Payment fraud decision
workloads.detail: A risk decision must return while authorization is waiting.
workloads.stakes: A timeout needs an explicit approve, decline, or review policy.

workloads.label: Home-feed recommendations
workloads.detail: Large candidate sets meet fresh session context at request time.
workloads.stakes: Stale candidates reduce relevance; a slow reranker delays the page.

modes.label: Scheduled batch
modes.detail: Precompute complete predictions and serve a lookup.

modes.label: Request-time online
modes.detail: Fetch fresh features and infer on the request path.

modes.label: Hybrid retrieval and rerank
modes.detail: Precompute expensive candidates, then rerank with fresh context.
